description: Create a hosted PostgreSQL database in one step. Use when the app needs a database. Before: list_databases (needs database read access). With an app connected by OAuth, a person approves the database first (action backend.create). Returns the database and, this once, its connection url: store it as an environment secret, never print it. Scope: database:create ; the project balance must cover 24 hours. Cost: paid, billed per hour from the prepaid balance; the balance must cover 24 hours at creation (else next_action top_up_balance).

idempotency_key.description: Unique per request. Reuse it on retry.

name.description: Database name: 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

name: create_database
title: Create a hosted database
